evidence_gaps: No fresh runtime forensics within two hours; evidence.json explicitly reports MISSING_RUNTIME_FORENSICS.
No realised, wallet-reconciled money-weighted NET P&L by strategy, chain, asset, route and observation window.
No complete cost decomposition for EVM gas/base fee, priority fee, builder payment, DEX fee, realised slippage/impact and reverted-attempt costs.
No complete Solana decomposition for base/priority fees, platform/swap fees, realised slippage/impact, account creation, refundable rent and failed-attempt costs.
No runtime attribution separating STRATEGY/MARKET losses from EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE failures.
No attempt funnel containing opportunities, eligible signals, submissions, confirmations, fills, exits, failures and paid failure costs.
No predicted-versus-realised edge calibration or latency/adverse-selection distribution.
No out-of-sample and forward holdout results across congestion, volatility and liquidity regimes.
No asset/route concentration, drawdown, tail-loss or capital-duration evidence.
No evidence of exit sellability success and round-trip completion rates for Solana assets.
No promotion-quality evidence; quote and simulation scorecards are explicitly non-promotional.

proposals.downside_risk: Schema migration and attribution rules can create discontinuities or double-count costs unless transaction identifiers and reconciliation invariants are enforced.

evidence.detail: Window records expose fees and slippage, but no dedicated gas/priority fee, price-impact, failed-attempt cost, rent, builder payment or failure-class fields; supplied net_profit can bypass recomputation.
Promotion candidacy uses aggregate net profit and gross-profit/gross-loss profit factor without cost-adjusted downside attribution.
EVM features include gas and builder costs, but these are folded into a generic fee field.
Chain transaction fees are available for Solana and EVM, providing an architectural source for cost reconciliation.

proposals.expected_effect: Prevents apparent edge from omitted costs, supports chain-specific diagnosis, and stops infrastructure incidents from contaminating strategy replacement decisions while still charging their monetary cost.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 30 independent daily windows, 200 completed or failed attempts per chain type, and coverage of at least three distinct fee/congestion regimes; promotion additionally requires positive out-of-sample money-weighted net P&L after all reconciled costs with no unresolved accounting residuals.
proposals.rationale: Durable money-weighted NET P&L requires immutable, reconcilable cost components and mutually exclusive outcome attribution. An adverse filled trade after complete costs is STRATEGY/MARKET loss; simulation, RPC, stale-blockhash, revert, dropped transaction, quote mismatch or missing confirmation is EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE failure. Failed attempts may still consume gas or priority fees and must reduce net P&L without being mislabeled as market losses.
proposals.shadow_test: In SHADOW, reconcile every attempted outcome to wallet/receipt deltas and independently recompute net P&L. For EVM subtract DEX fees, realised slippage/impact, gas, priority and builder payments, including reverted attempts. For Solana subtract swap/platform fees, priority/base transaction fees, realised impact and non-refundable account/rent effects while tracking refundable rent separately. Require exactly one attribution class: STRATEGY_MARKET or EXECUTION_INFRASTRUCTURE. Stop if any cost is double-counted, unexplained residual exceeds 1% of notional, or attribution is missing.

proposals.downside_risk: Quote sampling may understate latency, adverse selection and congestion; repeated quote requests can also encounter rate limits and selection bias.

evidence.detail: Solana leader events deliberately populate gross edge, fees, slippage, impact, liquidity and sellability as zero and mark current executable edge unproven.
Execution architecture already captures pre/post native-wallet snapshots and simulates the signed Jupiter transaction.
Common eligibility requires positive cost-adjusted edge, liquidity, sellability and quote freshness, so missing Solana measurements currently fail closed.

proposals.expected_effect: Creates falsifiable Solana opportunity evidence without weakening existing execution protections or treating copied historical returns as current edge.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 500 independent candidate observations across 30 days, 100 simulated round trips, multiple liquidity and priority-fee regimes, and asset-level holdout evaluation with no promotion based solely on repeated quotes.
proposals.rationale: Historical leader performance is not an executable Solana signal. A SHADOW-only adapter should obtain contemporaneous round-trip quotes at intended size, signed-transaction simulation results, price impact, platform/swap fees, priority fees, account effects, quote age and sellability before estimating net edge.
proposals.shadow_test: For each otherwise eligible leader event, record timestamped entry and executable exit quotes at intended size, simulation status and all Solana-specific costs. Reprice after observed decision-to-confirmation latency and compare predicted net edge with a no-trade counterfactual outcome. Stop the hypothesis if sellability cannot be proven, failure rate exceeds 5%, median predicted-to-observed erosion consumes the edge, or money-weighted net outcome after all costs is non-positive.

proposals.downside_risk: Paper execution cannot reproduce every mempool interaction, so results may remain optimistic even with latency replay.

evidence.detail: EVM outcome availability requires exact quote, simulation, liquidity, sellability and route approval, but its outcome basis remains EXACT_QUOTE_AND_SIMULATION.
Quote-simulated net is derived directly from expected net-edge basis points and is explicitly not realised P&L.
EVM cycle simulation reserves gas and minimum profit and fails closed when the conservative reserve removes edge.

proposals.expected_effect: Measures executable edge erosion and identifies whether losses are STRATEGY/MARKET outcomes or EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE failures under actual chain conditions.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 30 days, 300 eligible observations and 100 replayable outcomes per EVM chain and route family, spanning low and high gas regimes with a strictly later holdout window.
proposals.rationale: The EVM gates are economically sensible, but simulation cannot establish durable returns under state contention, MEV, inclusion delay, base-fee movement and failed-attempt costs. These effects must be calibrated per chain and route before promotion.
proposals.shadow_test: Replay exact candidate routes against subsequent blocks using decision-time state, intended sizing, observed inclusion latency, DEX fees, realised impact, EIP-1559 base/priority fees, builder payments and revert costs. Compare predicted versus replayed money-weighted net P&L by chain and route. Stop any route family if net P&L is non-positive, lower-confidence net expectancy is non-positive, or execution/infrastructure failure costs erase more than 25% of predicted gross edge.

rejected_ideas.idea: Promote any strategy because aggregate SHADOW net profit or win rate is positive.
rejected_ideas.reason: Current SHADOW economics are quote/simulation evidence, not realised out-of-sample P&L; win count is not the objective.

rejected_ideas.idea: Relax liquidity, sellability, simulation or minimum-edge gates to increase participation.
rejected_ideas.reason: More trades without positive executable edge increase exposure to impact, failed exits and infrastructure costs.

rejected_ideas.idea: Use profitable Solana leader history as proof of current copy edge.
rejected_ideas.reason: The repository correctly records that contemporaneous Solana quote and execution economics are missing; latency and price impact make historical leader returns non-transferable.
Non-atomic legs expose capital to state changes and partial execution; the repository marks such candidates SHADOW-only pending atomic execution.

summary: Architecture-only review completed. The repository generally fails closed, keeps SHADOW evaluation non-signing, requires positive estimated edge, and explicitly prevents quote simulations from serving as promotion evidence. However, Strategy Lab accounting does not structurally capture every chain-specific cost and does not separate STRATEGY/MARKET losses from EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE failures. Solana SHADOW observations intentionally lack contemporaneous executable quotes, while EVM SHADOW outcomes are simulations rather than realised fills. Profitability, CANARY readiness and LIVE readiness therefore cannot be claimed.
